scoring_justification: Mechanical moduli (Young, shear, Poisson) are recomputed from agent-reported elastic constants using the checker. Other properties (lattice parameters, cohesive energy, band gap, Cij, optical absorption) are compared directly to paper gold with tolerances; recompute from raw DFT results is infeasible within the lightweight verifier sandbox.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for all scored properties of PPD monolayer (relaxed_a, relaxed_b, cohesive_energy, electronic_band_gap, C11, C22, C12, C66, Young_modulus_min/max, shear_modulus_min/max, Poisson_ratio_min/max, phonon_imaginary_frequencies, absorption_xx_at_0_8eV, absorption_yy_at_2_3eV)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Values extracted from the paper: relaxed lattice parameters a=6.70 Å, b=3.80 Å; cohesive energy -7.23 eV/atom; band gap 0 eV (metallic); elastic constants C11=235.06 N/m, C22=225.76 N/m, C12=81.25 N/m, C66=55.89 N/m; Young's modulus min 164.46 N/m, max 205.83 N/m; shear modulus min 55.89 N/m, max 74.55 N/m; Poisson's ratio min 0.346, max 0.472; phonon stability confirmed (no imaginary frequencies); optical absorption at 0.8 eV (xx) ~1.5%, at 2.3 eV (yy) ~4.0%.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly transcribed from paper's reported numbers and verified against the reference solve.sh artifacts.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported values for the same quantities; the checker compares the agent's reproduced/recomputed values against them with tolerances appropriate for typical DFT code/pseudopotential variability.

outputs.description: Aggregated structural, electronic, mechanical, and optical properties of the 2D monolayer. The checker compares each numeric field against the paper’s reported values with tolerances appropriate for DFT code differences.

output_contract.notes: The agent must perform all DFT simulations and compile the results. The checker uses a hidden reference (the paper’s values) to score the submitted properties per-field.

steps.description: Score all properties of PPD monolayer
